magic_fields.name: Sacred
magic_fields.domain_note: Will for devotional concentration; Presence for formal invocation.
magic_fields.description: Devotional practice, liturgy, purification, consecration, divine invocation.

magic_fields.name: Warding
magic_fields.description: Protective barriers, seals, anti-corruption protocols, ward construction and maintenance.
examples: Maintaining a long-standing ward on a building

magic_fields.name: Binding
magic_fields.domain_note: Will for sustained oath concentration; Presence for command recognition.
magic_fields.description: Oaths, pacts, compulsions, sworn duties, channeled authority with magical weight.
examples: Binding a summoned creature to a task

magic_fields.name: Elemental
magic_fields.description: Raw elemental channeling through sustained output — fire, cold, lightning, stone, wind.
examples: Calling a focused gust to clear mist

magic_fields.name: Druidry
magic_fields.description: Living-systems magic: biome work, ley-flow manipulation, plant and animal shaping, ecosystem intervention. Renamed from the prior 'nature' field to avoid collision with the Nature knowledge group.
examples: Awakening a grove into active defense

magic_fields.name: Illusion
magic_fields.description: Constructed perception: false images, sensory manipulation, glamour, disguise magic.
examples: Projecting a phantom self across a room
Planting a false memory of appearance

magic_fields.name: Runecraft
magic_fields.description: Inscribed magical structures: runes, glyphs, sigils, permanent enchantment through written work.
examples: Inscribing a ward rune onto a door

magic_fields.name: Alchemy
magic_fields.description: Magical compound preparation, transmutation, reagent work, potion and tincture crafting.
examples: Transmuting lead into a ritual component
Preparing reagents for a larger working

magic_fields.name: Necromancy
magic_fields.description: Death energy, undead interaction, life-force manipulation. Culturally forbidden or restricted in most civilized areas.
examples: Reading a death imprint on a body
Compelling a restless shade to speak
